<details>
The PKGBUILD file defines a standard AUR package for a pinned version of the Electron binary (36.6.0), intended for compatibility with the Nyxt browser's cl-electron library. The source is fetched directly from the official Electron GitHub releases page over HTTPS, which is a trusted and expected location. The SHA-256 checksum is explicitly provided and matches the expected value for the release, ensuring integrity.

The build process consists of unpacking the prebuilt binary archive, installing it into the package directory, creating a simple wrapper script to launch Electron, setting appropriate permissions on the chrome-sandbox binary (a known requirement for Electron apps), and installing license files. All operations are confined to the package directory and follow standard packaging practices for binary packages in Arch Linux.

There are no signs of obfuscated code, unauthorized network requests, or suspicious file operations. The use of `base64 -d` in the maintainer comment is only for encoding the email address and does not execute during the build. No dangerous commands (e.g., `curl|bash`, `eval`, or remote code execution) are present. The package is SAFE.
</details>
